name: Ricochet
summary: In Ricochet, you control a paddle at the bottom of the screen, bouncing a ball upward to destroy blocks. Each hit makes a block vanish and sends the ball ricocheting back, requiring quick reactions to keep it in play. The goal is to eliminate the building blocks of the universe to prevent Dimension-5 from collapsing into a white dwarf. You have three lives, and precision and timing are key to survival.
